readme: ENEMY LIBRARY CATALOG. One entry per library type a fight can name in combat_lib_N (combat.txt fight_library).
Edit this file, then run: node tools/gen_enemies.js   (it rewrites the GEN blocks in web/mygame/scenes/combat_types.txt).
node tools/gen_enemies.js --check fails when the blocks are stale; node tools/test_enemy_catalog.js builds every type in the real engine and checks it.
A new type also needs its prose: a *label flavor_type_<id> and its line in flavor_from_type (combat_prose.txt). The generator refuses a type without them.
Fields:
id            the combat_lib_N value, also the slot's flavor_type. lower_snake_case.
name, epithet the banner name and the in-prose reference ("the archer"). A fight can rename either with the _override variables.
hp, ac        hit points (also max) and armour class. A fight can override both per slot.
creature_type humanoid | beast | plant | undead (rules-facing: items, abilities, encounter logic).
size          small | medium | large (Shove and the like).
profile       behaviour profile, resolved by combat_types.txt resolve_behavior_profile: feral | bruiser | skirmisher | sharpshooter | caster | guardian.
The profile sets chase chance, retreat and the wounded flee point; a type never sets those itself.
morale        fearless (never breaks) | steady (morale saves with advantage) | normal | skittish (with disadvantage): see combat.txt MORALE.
reach         a ranged type's reach class: touch | short | medium | long (default long). Ignored for melee.
attack        weapon_type melee | ranged, dice (damage die sides), dmg_type; optional atk_bonus / dmg_bonus to fix the numbers instead of
deriving them from the rolled ability scores (apply_derived_combat_bonuses).
abilities     [low, high] roll range for each of the six scores.
move2         optional special move: chance (percent), atk_bonus (added to the basic attack's), dice, dmg_bonus, dmg_type, and an optional
condition {name, icon} it leaves on a hit.
sidearm       optional close-range weapon a ranged type draws when cornered: weapon_type, dice, dmg_type, and atk_bonus / dmg_bonus as a
number or "weapon" (the same bonus as its main attack, e.g. a DEX archer's dagger).
vulnerable    optional damage types it takes double from, space-separated.
stun          optional {name, icon}: every hit stuns, so the player or ally it hits loses their next turn, has no reactions until then, and is
attacked with advantage (combat_dice.txt resolve_enemy_attack and _on_ally, combat.txt combat_stun_gate and combat_can_react).
notes         design notes, copied into the generated label as comments.

types.name: Swordsman
notes: Sword fighter: measured cuts and thrusts, a little harder to hit (AC 12). Move 2 (30%) is a beat and a double cut
that drives the player off guard (Off-Guard). Not balance-simmed.

types.name: Axeman
notes: Axe fighter: short, brutal chops. Move 2 (30%) is a wild full-strength swing that tears a deep gash and leaves the
player Bleeding (disadvantage on the next attack, like every condition-on-hit here -- the name is flavor).

types.name: Knifeman
notes: Knife fighter: quick, close, short-reach cuts. Move 2 (30%) is a blade smeared with something dark and foul that
leaves the player Poisoned. The only human type that poisons.

types.name: Maceman
notes: Mace fighter: heavy, close, brutal swings. Move 2 (30%) is a two-handed overhead skull-crack that leaves the
player Dazed.

types.name: Spearman
notes: Spear fighter: long reach, thrusts and sweeps. Move 2 (30%) pins the player's weapon arm against the shaft
(Pinned). Not balance-simmed.

types.name: Hookman
notes: Hooked-pole fighter: long reach, hooks and drags. Move 2 (30%) snags the player and hauls them off their feet,
leaving them Off-Balance.

types.name: Archer
notes: Bow fighter: fragile (7 HP, AC 10) but hits hard from range. Move 2 (25%) is a shot at the legs (Hobbled).
Not balance-simmed.

types.name: Slinger
notes: Sling fighter, deliberately weak (6 HP, AC 10, +2 for d4) so a bruiser-and-slinger ambush lands near the
Silt-Lurker's overall difficulty rather than a wipe for casters (see the balance sim). Move 2 (25%) is a fistful
of grit in the eyes -> Blinded.
Reach medium: a sling cannot hit from the far end of the lane, so it must close (an archer is long).

types.name: Guard
notes: Plain mace-armed hired muscle, no movepool/condition. fight_rennick_guards (Alderford's curing shed) fills two
slots with it, renamed Left and Right.

types.name: Lacedon
notes: A drowned, clawing undead: quick, close, hard to hold. Stats are the Silt-Lurker of Alderford's cellar quest.
Mindless -- never sets combat_enemy_chase_chance (2026-09-29), so it stays at the *create default of 0
and roll_enemy_chase_commit's own >0 gate always skips it. It fights whatever's in front of it and
never breaks formation to hunt a squishier target; that's a human, tactical judgment call this undead
doesn't make.

types.name: Zombie
notes: A risen corpse (the Zombie of Chapter 5; the source's Risen Corpse: 22 HP, AC 8, Slam +3 for 1d6+1 bludgeoning, poison immunity; set the immunity on the fight, combat_enemy_immune_override "poison"). UNDEAD FORTITUDE (RAW) belongs to this library type:

when damage drops it to 0 HP it makes a Constitution save (DC 5 + the damage) and stays up at 1 HP on a success, unless the damage is radiant or the blow was a natural 20 (combat.txt fight_undead_fortitude reads the slot's flavor_type "zombie"). Mindless: it
keeps the *create default chase chance of 0 and fights whatever is in front of it.

types.name: Beast
notes: A generic natural-attack monster with no special move: 9 HP, AC 11, +3 to hit, d6+1. A scene makes it a wolf, a
boar or a ghoul by naming it, and a tougher or weaker one with the hp, ac and atk overrides. Not balance-simmed.
Mindless -- same reasoning as apply_type_lacedon's own comment: never sets combat_enemy_chase_chance,
stays at 0, never breaks formation.

types.name: Mire-Rat
notes: Big-as-a-cat vermin: fragile and fast, meant to come in threes. Stats are Alderford's granary rats.
Mindless -- same reasoning as apply_type_lacedon's own comment: never sets combat_enemy_chase_chance,
stays at 0, never breaks formation.
2026-11-03: slots 2 and up used to roll DEX 14-16 against slot 1's 13-15 (a copy that drifted); the catalog keeps slot 1's 13-15 for every slot.

types.name: Hedge-Mage
notes: A wandering caster: 22 HP, AC 12, and Poison Spray from range, an ordinary ranged attack at +4 for 1d12 poison (the engine has no save-based attacks for enemies, so the spell is a spell attack). When the player gets close he drops to the

quarterstaff sidearm, 1d6+2 (the same machinery the archers use for a dagger; flavor_type_hedge_mage_dagger), and falls back when he can. Sharpshooter profile. Not balance-simmed. The Burning Grove's Dubhar (longshade_forest.txt).
Reach medium: Poison Spray reaches 30 feet, so like a player casting it he must be within Mid-Range.

types.name: Twig Blight
notes: A small plant creature of twig and bramble: 7 HP, AC 14, a claw of knotted wood for 1d4+2, and vulnerable to fire (double fire damage: Control Flames' spread and Alchemist's Fire catch a whole pack). Mindless like the lacedon: never sets
a chase chance, so it fights whatever is in front of it. Small. Not balance-simmed.
